workarounds.note: a :::space at the top of a box is dropped, so every answer box opens with a prompt line (Write here, My plant is called, I think, I saw) before its :::space; a box of :::space alone collapses to its 3.6 mm of padding (measured)
a chip of spaces prints its markup, so the blanks, the matching dots and the checklist circles hold a U+2060 word joiner (EMPTY)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
the opener's plant disc is an image and does not count towards the height the opener reserves; minHeight (DISC.y + DISC.d + AIR - TOP) holds the text below it
the canvas leaves hairline seams between filled table cells, so the white matching table draws a grid of white 1 pt rules over its white body fill
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es')
the palette does not reach design-slot colours or bodyText.referenceColor; col() writes the hex beside every paletteId, so the band, the dots and the footer keep their colours
the band title's design lineHeight is the multiple 0.98, never a Dimension

list numbers are painted by the same renderBullet as contents numbers, centred 0.3 em above the text's baseline, so Baloo 2 800 numbers sat 0.6 mm high beside Andika; orderedLists.numberVerticalOffset pt(1.7) sets them on the baseline (measured within 1 px at 150 dpi)

a ::resource table (or figure) at position 'here' inside a callout gets no space above or below it (0 mm, against 4.2 mm above and 2.1 mm below in the running text, measured with the default config); the card puts :::space{lines=0.33} (2 mm, the ASK gap) before the embed (gotcha box-embed-no-gap)
